ios.desc:
Freaking Math is back - and it is still smarter than you.

The rules are stupidly simple. The game is freakishly hard.

An equation flashes on screen. Is it TRUE or FALSE? You have about ONE SECOND to decide. Get it right and keep going. Get it wrong and it is game over. No solving, no typing - just your gut, your reflexes, and a clock that never blinks.

Sounds easy? 12 + 7 = 20. TRUE or FALSE? Tick tick tick... yeah. That is the trap.

BACK TO SCHOOL READY
Kids Zone is the math drill your child never knew they wanted. Build a custom session in seconds: pick any operation, set the number range or choose exact multiplication tables, decide how many questions. No timer breathing down their neck. Wrong answer? The correct one flashes so they learn before moving on. Math practice they will actually ask for.

WHY IT WILL DRIVE YOU CRAZY (in a good way)
- One-second answers that turn your brain to mush
- "Just one more try" energy that ruins your bedtime
- The perfect blend of simple, brutal and stupidly fun

GAME MODES FOR EVERY KIND OF PAIN
- Classic: pure addition speed, the original nightmare
- Subtraction, Multiplication and Division: pick your poison
- Mixed / Stress: every operation, zero mercy
- 20-Second Challenge: score as much as you can before time runs out
- Relax: 10 seconds per question, for when your ego needs a break
- For Your Kids: pick operations and number ranges, choose your question count, zero time pressure

2 PLAYERS, ONE DEVICE
- Lay a phone flat between you, or stand a tablet up side by side
- Same equation on both halves: the first right answer scores, a wrong guess scores nothing
- Every classic mode, Relax, the weekend event and your Kids Zone setups
- No account, no internet. Rematch in one tap

COMPETE AND SHOW OFF
- Global leaderboards for every mode (Game Center)
- Unlock achievements from your First Play all the way to Master
- Share this score and dare your friends to beat it

WEEKEND EVENTS
- Friday through Sunday only: a rotating twist on the core loop
- Stress, Blitz (even faster), or Liars (every equation is false)
- Miss it and it is gone until next weekend

KEEP YOUR BESTS
- Sign in with Apple or Google to keep high scores across devices
- A best for every mode, saved in the cloud

BUILT TO FEEL GOOD
- Clean, colorful, distraction-free design with a fresh color every round
- Snappy sounds and haptics that make every correct answer satisfying
- Free to play, fast to start, impossible to put down

Whether you are killing
